messages:
Marta: Quick sync — we have 4 open docs PRs that need reviewers before EOD: https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls. Can folks volunteer? Prefer someone who can also check the docs preview build.

docs-bot: Preview URLs generated:
• PR #421: https://docs-preview.internal/pr-421 
• PR #422: https://docs-preview.internal/pr-422 
• PR #423: https://docs-preview.internal/pr-423 
• PR #424: https://docs-preview.internal/pr-424

Alice: I can take PR #421 (SDK snippets + example). Will validate code samples run and regenerate snippets. :+1:

PJ: I can pick up PR #423 (API reference + small table fix). I’ll also check cross-links.

Sam: I’ll do PR #424 (link fixes + copy nits). Quick wins.

Marta: Amazing, thanks. That leaves PR #422 — migration guide from v0 -> v1, it's more involved. Any volunteers? Needs reviewer who can run the preview and skim the migration steps for accuracy.

Lev: I can look at #422 but heads up — looks like our docs-review rotation doc might be out of date. If no urgent reviewer, I can triage and assign a reviewer from infra/docs rotation.

Marta: If you can triage, please do. We still want a named reviewer for the migration guide though.

PJ: @Lev — if you triage, can you confirm the person is comfortable with migration/compatibility details? Might need an infra engineer eyeballs.

Lev: Will do. I’ll ping the infra rotation and tag someone.

ci-bot: CI status for PRs:
• PR #421 — docs-preview: success
• PR #422 — docs-preview: failed (build error in mkdocs step)
• PR #423 — docs-preview: success
• PR #424 — docs-preview: success

Marta: Ok #422 is failing. @Lev — can you try to repro and if it’s a simple mkdocs config issue, please fix or assign to whoever authored the PR. If it’s content-related we’ll need the author to update.

Lev: Reproduced locally, missing YAML frontmatter on one page causing mkdocs to abort. I’ll add a quick fix and push to the PR branch unless author objects.

Alice: Fine by me to push minor fixes. For future: small tip for SDK snippet PRs — run `make docs-preview` locally and `python -m pip install -r docs/requirements.txt` before building; that caught a deps mismatch for me earlier.

Marta: Good call. Can we also please tag reviewers in the PR body with the checklist: 
- has preview URL
- examples run locally
- no broken links
- CI green

PJ: Yep I’ll add that checklist to #423 and leave a review.

Sam: Merging plan? For pressure — prioritize #421 and #422 (once CI fixed). Others can wait for normal review window.

Marta: Agreed. If anyone needs help with the preview link or repro steps, ping me. Thanks all. :rocket:

Lev: Updated PR #422 with YAML fix and retriggered preview: https://docs-preview.internal/pr-422

ci-bot: PR #422 — docs-preview: success

Marta: Perfect. @Alice and @Lev — when you both confirm examples and migration steps, we can merge #421 and #422 today.

Alice: Confirmed examples run and code blocks match SDK v1.0. I left minor comment about a path in one example.

Lev: Confirmed migration steps are accurate, pushed one wording tweak.

Marta: Cool — I’ll do final quick pass and merge both after you two approve. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
